script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N/runtime" --expect 200 --check runtime_status eq available --save F12.runtime-cold/after-pause
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/runtime/reprovision" --expect 200 --check runtime_status eq available
control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/owner_lease.json' --expect-count 0
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/runtime" --expect 200 --check runtime_status eq available --check can_resume eq true --save F12.runtime-cold/after-restart
control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/owner_lease.json' --expect-count 0
